decision: Continue testing. Extracted the four current crypto providers for 71 days with zero differences in 364 sampled rolling comparisons. Full six-route economics remain pending: the current SNDK provider demonstrably differs from its research onset rule. Resolve that exact contract defect before claiming joint current-policy fidelity. No live changes or profitability conclusion.
falsifier: Source or generator hash drift, mismatched provider identity/side/exit/sizing, future-information use, unsupported private-fill assumptions, marking through undocumented data gaps, double-counted positions, inconsistent fees/funding or rescaled predecessor trades presented as exact current-contract evidence invalidate the corresponding replay claim.
hypothesis: The six current executable contracts can be causally reconstructed and combined on one account without substituting predecessor strategies, changing sizing precedence, or overstating portfolio fitness from isolated outcomes.
limitations: No new profitability claim or deployment recommendation is made by preregistration.
Bar or book-mid proxies cannot prove private IOC fills, venue-native mark risk or public candle parity.
Independent future observations remain necessary to update weak current-contract samples.

metrics.cost_rule: Use pinned venue fee rates and route-specific maker/taker role, historical funding cashflows and source-specific depth/latency; report unavailable fill precision explicitly.
metrics.date_selection_rule: Use maximal verified common coverage for the six assets, with separate full-coverage route panels; freeze exact timestamps and hashes before joint returns. The registry envelope alone is not coverage.
metrics.entry_rule: Production eligibility, directions, entry delay limits and 20-bps IOC caps remain binding; delayed orders that expire or cannot fill are reported missed, not assumed executed.
metrics.exit_rule: Use exact provider targets, stops, opposite/recipe exits, profit-lock and soft/hard hold policies; preserve reduce-only ownership and realistic adverse ordering.
metrics.generator_provenance: The exact generator bytes used for the large artifact are archived. The current CLI only extracts its parser/manifest helpers to meet function length limits; integration tests cover current CLI publication.
metrics.next_step: Correct or explicitly replace SNDK current onset semantics using durable prior pressure state; preserve V86 as the control and validate restart, stale/gap boundaries and chronological replay before any live proposal.
metrics.portfolio_rule: One position per symbol, seven configured slots, six executable directions, shared causal equity, production directional sizing precedence and current notional caps. No arbitrary slot filling.
required_outputs: all valid trade and cost records
metrics.selection_disclosure: All existing historical strategy partitions have been inspected under prior work. This is fidelity/interaction validation on opened data, not a new untouched holdout.
metrics.window_selection_disclosure: Core extraction spans the first full UTC day following the SPCX archive lower envelope through the common core cache upper bound. This is an adapter validation panel, not a claim of maximal verified six-asset coverage. Joint return timestamps remain to be frozen after HIP-3 source and warmup validation.
